description: This PHP class defines the entity 'SelectedDisplayFieldGroup' used in the OrangeHRM system, encapsulating database mappings and relationships for selected display field groups within reports.

classes.name: SelectedDisplayFieldGroup
classes.description: A Doctrine ORM-mapped entity representing a selected display field group linked to reports and display field group entities.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the SelectedDisplayFieldGroup.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the SelectedDisplayFieldGroup.

methods.name: setReport
methods.description: Sets the Report entity for this selected display field group.

methods.name: setDisplayFieldGroup
methods.description: Sets the DisplayFieldGroup entity for this selected display field group.
